name: triceps-extension-dumbbell-bent-over-two-arm
title: Triceps Extension: Dumbbell (Bent-Over, Two Arm)
primer: This exercise uses a kickback movement to work the triceps in both arms at once.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and your back straight as you bend at the waist until your upper body is parallel to the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring your arms up to your sides so the dumbbells are in line with your chest, keeping your lower arms vertical, and press your arms back in an arc.
Return to the starting position and repeat.
